title: Game Over? Assessing the Impact of Gamification Discontinuation on Mobile Banking Behaviors
eligible_reason: Single adoption date. The treatment `event` is 1 for every user on and after the one-time shutdown of the bank app's gamified reward module (January 2022; code comments date the shutdown to around Jan 19-20, 2022). All users are treated on the same calendar date, so there is only one adoption cohort and no never-treated group. Identification comes from an age-period-cohort structure (tenure fixed effects days_in_panel plus user, day-of-month and day-of-week FE; no calendar-date FE in the Table 2 ATT model), not from staggered adoption. Fails the at-least-two-adoption-dates rule. In addition, no data are shipped (NDA with Flourish; only one fictional user's rows in data_example.xlsx).
design_notes: User-day panel of mobile-banking customers who signed up for a gamified reward module (monthly signup cohorts Aug 2021-Jan 2022). Table 2 (Model 1): reghdfe login_app / tbillpay / LoanRepays on event, a(userid day dow days_in_panel) cluster(userid) (Analyses_Stata.do lines 57-59); `day` is day of month, `dow` day of week, `days_in_panel` tenure since signup; no calendar-date FE. Table 3: event##i.cohort_2 (monthly cohort interactions). Table 4: event plus time-varying engagement regressors. Model 2 (R, felm with ~0 | days_in_panel + userid + date + day + dow) is an age-period-cohort decomposition with date FE and no treatment regressor (Figure 5). Appendix: twowayfeweights (A.2.4), de Chaisemartin-D'Haultfoeuille (A.2.5), placebo pseudo-shutdowns poct/pnov/pdec (A.4), cohort-week aggregation (A.5).
n_adoption_cohorts_note: One shutdown date for all users; signup cohorts (Aug 2021-Jan 2022) differ in tenure at treatment but not in treatment date.

specs.exclusion_reason: single adoption date (one shutdown for all users); no calendar-date FE
specs.treatment_definition: 1 on and after the reward-module shutdown (same date for every user)
specs.time_var: date (daily); FE use day-of-month, day-of-week and tenure instead of date
specs.notes: tbillpay (line 58, if bp_exclude==0) and LoanRepays (line 59, if lr_exclude==0) analogous.

ineligible_specs.reason: time-varying engagement regressors n_login_reward_last14, cash_last14; single adoption date
alternative samples, single adoption date; twowayfeweights diagnostics

screener_notes: Screened from package only (no article text).
